faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Motivator post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Motivator post is 30th September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the Motivator position?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for the Motivator position is passing the 10th class examination.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Motivator recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for the Motivator post is 21 years. There is no upper age limit specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Motivator post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Motivator post is Rs. 2000 per month fixed, with an additional variable component of up to Rs. 3000 per month, totaling a potential of Rs. 5000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Motivator post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Motivator post in the District Development Commissioner Ganderbal recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly online. Candidates need to apply through the official website of the District Development Commissioner Ganderbal.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the Motivator post?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Motivator post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Motivator role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an online application followed by an empanelment stage. Candidates are advised to follow the application guidelines carefully.

faq.question: Q9. Which district is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for the District Development Commissioner Ganderbal, located in Jammu and Kashmir.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF and the online application link can be found in the "Important Links" section of this article. You can also visit the official website for more details.
